rigid_mass.reference: Closed rectangular solid with uniform or affine density, translated reference point and parallel-axis theorem. Slender cuboid axial inertia m(b²+d²)/12.
rigid_mass.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_rigid_body_mass.py tests/test_rigid_body_mass_invariant_battery.py tests/test_rigid_body_mass_inhomogeneous.py tests/test_rigid_body_mass_wetted_hull_inertia.py tests/test_rigid_body_mass_equivalent_inertia.py tests/test_rigid_body_mass_topology.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=results.xml

wigley.reference: Polynomial integration of each principal moment of the longitudinally modified Wigley hull, plus KB = 5T/8.
wigley.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_w25_rao_truncation.py tests/test_wigley3_hull_alpha_axis.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=results.xml
